verdict: Yes. GROWiT from Surat pitched protective farming products such as crop covers and nets on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Covers, mulch films and nets protect crops from weather and pests and raise yields, and farmers see the results in one season.
angle: Farmers growing vegetables and fruit lose crops to heavy rain, heat and pests. Crop covers, shade nets and mulch films are affordable and easy to explain in a field demonstration. Dealers and FPOs are the main channels.
